Services

Hosting, domains and DNS, looked after together.

Keep the technical foundations of your website and email connected, with clear business ownership and one place to ask for help.

Talk through your needs ↗

One place to manage the technical foundations.

A domain, website host and email provider can sit in separate accounts. When something changes, it is not always clear which service controls what. We help identify the pieces, document ownership and manage the agreed technical work.

Web services start from £10 per month. No VAT is charged. The estimate explains the hosting and maintenance included for your site; domain registration, renewals, email and additional work are priced separately.

The simple website build offer starts from £100 one-off and requires OS Technology hosting from £10/month. A build and its ongoing hosting are separate charges, with the scope confirmed before work begins.

Already have a provider?

Start with the current setup.

Tell us where the domain, website and email are held. We check access and dependencies before proposing a transfer or changing records.

Discuss your existing services ↗

Connected services

Hosting, names and records kept in order.

Website hosting

Provide hosting suited to the agreed website and explain what ongoing technical maintenance is included. New functionality and content changes can be scoped separately.

Domain registration and transfers

Help register a new domain or transfer an existing one where appropriate. Keep the domain associated with your business and make renewal responsibilities clear.

DNS management

Manage the records that connect your domain to your website, email and other agreed services. Check the existing records so a website change does not accidentally disconnect email.

Ongoing technical help

Have a point of contact for the services we manage. We identify responsibilities and the work covered in your estimate rather than assuming every future change is included.

Move carefully

Check what depends on your domain.

Before changing providers, we review the domain access, website requirements and connected email services. Transfers depend on the current provider and domain arrangements; we explain the proposed sequence and any dependencies before making changes.

If the website needs replacing too, we can combine the work in a tailored modernisation estimate. If email is moving, we plan that as a separate part of the change.
